name: pygg
description: Hand coding subtasks from Claude Code to cheaper agents through Pygg, a local AI gateway: each runs in its own Git worktree, is checked by the checks you approved, and becomes a branch only when you keep it. Needs the Pygg app (Windows) or its command line running.

pygg_token.title: Pygg client token
pygg_token.description: A Pygg API key allowed to start tasks: in the Pygg app, Endpoint → API Keys, then Limits… → May start tasks (or `pygg gateway create-client --name claude-code` and `pygg gateway client --name claude-code --tasks yes`). It starts tasks only; it reaches no model connection.
